message.reasoning_content: Round 5 market, sell prices at counter 6: prices [5,4,3,3,2...]. Selling 4 gives 5+4+3+3=15 alashi, cash 72.5. Keep 4 units to sell next round? Round 6 devalues cash by /100*62 — cash will be devalued! So selling now means cash devalued at round 6 start. Promissory added after devaluation, not devalued. So sell_credit preserves value! Sell credit 4: promissory 18.75, plus cash 57.5 stays. That's better than sell (72.5 devalued to ~44.9). Also goods kept for round 6 could sell then... but no, sell all 4 via credit now — promissory pays after round 6 devaluation, and last round? Promissory not paid after last round — round 6 market sell_credit gives promissory that never pays. This is round 5, promissory pays at round 6 start (after devaluation). So sell_credit 4 now → 18.75 promissory, cash 57.5. Total after round 6 deval: 35.65+18.75=54.4 vs sell now: 72.5→44.95. Credit wins.
